Define the pet-food category Identify dry kibble, treats, freeze-dried products or wet food, together with fill weight and storage conditions. Review product edges, seal cleanliness and repeat opening in a filled sample. Wet-food processing and dry-food storage need different validation. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals. Review the filled sample against shelf depth before fixing the dieline. Review zipper access and final sealing Confirm zipper location, usable opening and the final top-seal allowance. Check filling access, opening and reclosing with the actual contents. Include any valve as a separate specified component. Choose one final layer structure in the quotation; do not combine the lists into an assumed laminate. Confirm layer order, thicknesses, sealant and the testing needed for the intended contents.
